# HR Core Workflows & Use Cases

| Workflow | Operational requirement | Relevant capability pattern |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Recruitment | Convert job requirements and unstructured resumes into consistent screening inputs | AI-assisted job descriptions, resume extraction, screening and candidate profiles |
| Onboarding | Enter employee data once and trigger downstream configuration | Automated onboarding, attendance, payroll and social-insurance setup |
| Attendance and scheduling | Capture mobile, site, shift, overtime and exception data | Multi-scenario attendance, scheduling, approvals and location-aware controls |
| Performance | Align goals, execution and review across roles | OKR/KPI configuration, review records and manager visibility |
| Payroll | Apply multi-region and multi-role rules with fewer manual transfers | Attendance-to-payroll linkage, rule engine, tax/social-insurance fields and audit trail |
| HR analysis | Aggregate workforce data for operations and planning | Dashboards, reports, exceptions and controlled exports |
